notes.title: version 2.0.2
notes.content:
A small update
- Bug fixed: some achievements don't work
- add a new achievement: Short jump.
- Bug fixed: some maps don't have property start values
- Car a bit more slowed

notes.title: - NEW CAR PHYSICS - Update 2.0.0
notes.content:
Car physics
Completely new physics and the behavior of the car

Trailer

A new way to win stars
Now you get points for picking pumpkins and other actions such as flying or drifting.
Hit the car or respawn makes you lose points.

Pumpkins not collected left behind become violet and can not be picked.
Bonus points for fast arrival to the finish line.

Others changes
Remove some objects from the sides of the roads to make it easier
Icons are no longer pixelated
Presets buttons of video settings.
Light improvements in the scenarios

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.1 is here!!
notes.content:
Improvements in the control of the carMore speed and less weight of the car.It is more difficult for the car to make full spins when controlling the car.The brakes make less force and the handbrake is much stronger.
 
RacesImproved fog and placement of pumpkins on some maps.
 
BugsNow the horn does not echo if you repeatedly hit.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.0 is alive!!
notes.content:
Improved control of the car
Now is very difficult, almost impossible, to overturn in sharp curves.I also improved the control of the car while skidding and turning curves.Increased peak speed, and increased braking power and handbrake.When you overturn now they will get up faster.


9 new races
This version comes with 9 new races, now the game there are altogether 18 races.I used the maps already created with the layout in opposite direction with small changes where there were jumps.


Best light in the scenes
I have reviewed the scenes so they are not so dark and the car looks better and illuminated.


Bugs
It seems that if you were to continue on the last map exploded everything :S. Fixed.
